seller.name: Orrery Revenue Software
seller.sells: A revenue operations platform for B2B sales teams: pipeline, forecasting and territory planning. It is not a payments product.
seller.icp: B2B companies with 200 to 5000 employees that sell to other businesses and run a sales team. Strong fit: software, logistics technology, payments. Weak fit: agencies, consultancies, and companies that sell only to consumers.
seller.tier_rule: Tier 3: consumer-only business, agency or consultancy. Tier 1: B2B, 200 to 5000 employees, in a strong-fit segment (software, logistics technology, payments). Tier 2: any other B2B company that is either in the employee range or in a strong-fit segment. Tier 3: everything else.
